provenance.descriptors: Each native48-byte EventSequenceDef is independently reached through the event-sequence index, whose endpoints are selected by the sentinel-terminated debug selectors. The parallel byte-identical Shift-JIS event titles prove the regional correspondence; EU genuinely omits US event IDs127/128. Character tracks, camera keyframes, message entries, sound cues and background-effect entries are consumed through five distinct canonical pointer fields. Complete scalar fields match US/JP; EU native next-event IDs and the one timing change are preserved explicitly. No larger backing-script extent is inferred.
